WITH fee_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    orderslink,
    CASE 
      WHEN feerate IS NOT NULL AND feerate != 0 THEN rebrate / feerate 
      ELSE NULL 
    END as ratio
  FROM fees
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    orderslink,
    AVG(ratio) as group_avg,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM fee_ratios
  GROUP BY orderslink
  HAVING AVG(ratio) IS NOT NULL
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT 
  g.orderslink,
  g.group_avg,
  g.record_count,
  g.group_avg / o.overall_avg as ratio_of_averages
FROM group_stats g
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
ORDER BY 
  ratio_of_averages DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
